message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the super‑Jupiter **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a mass roughly 10–20 times that of Jupiter, making it one of the most massive planets ever discovered. However, because our observations are limited to what we can detect with current technology, there may well be even larger planets out there that we haven’t yet found.
